description: This file defines an admin controller class for handling log files in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for viewing, downloading, and clearing log files, as well as associated UI setup.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Controller class for handling log file operations such as viewing, downloading, and clearing logs within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of log files, with options to view, download, or clear each log.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading a specific log file to the user's device.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the contents of a specified log file after permission check.
